svg.title: Guardrails: check the prompt, the tool calls and the output
svg.desc: InputGuardrail checks the prompt before the model, ToolGuardrail checks tool arguments and results, and OutputGuardrail checks the final output before the caller. A table shows what each verdict does at each point.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
